characterizations.result_summary: Thermal decomposition temperatures of PC-1 to PC-6 were measured, with brominated polycarbonates exhibiting lower thermal stability but higher char yield.

evidence.source_sentence: The polymers from trichloromethyl chloroformate and various diols were characterized by elemental analysis, inherent viscosity, IR spectra, x-ray diffraction, solubility, thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), contact angle, and limiting oxygen index (LOI).
The thermal behavior of polymers was evaluated by means of TGA and DSC.

characterizations.result_summary: Glass transition temperatures of PC-1, PC-3 to PC-6 were measured in the range 141-206 °C, with brominated polycarbonates having higher Tg values.

evidence.source_sentence: The polymers from trichloromethyl chloroformate and various diols were characterized by elemental analysis, inherent viscosity, IR spectra, x-ray diffraction, solubility, thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), contact angle, and limiting oxygen index (LOI).

characterizations.result_summary: Inherent viscosities of synthesized polycarbonates ranged from 0.18 to 0.77 dL/g, with PC-1 having the highest value.

evidence.source_sentence: The inherent viscosities, $\eta_{inh}$, were measured with an Ubbelohde viscometer at a concentration 0.5 dL/g.
Table I presents inherent viscosity data of polycarbonates from two-phase phase-transfer-catalyzed polycondensation of bisphenols with TCF at 25°C.

characterizations.result_summary: FTIR spectra confirmed the presence of characteristic functional groups (C=O, C-O-C, SO2, Br, CH3) in all synthesized polycarbonates.

evidence.source_sentence: Infrared (IR) spectra in the range 4000–400 cm  $^{-1}$ of the synthesized monomers and polymers in solid state were obtained for samples in KBr disks (JASCO IR-700 spectrometer).

characterizations.result_summary: All synthesized polycarbonates were semicrystalline, with crystallinity ranging from 25.4% to 40.3%. PC-2 had the highest crystallinity, while brominated polycarbonates had lower crystallinity.
